references.text: Prohibition against withholding a worker's wages until the next day, the same principle of fair treatment for workers
The prophet Jeremiah condemns injustice toward workers who do not receive their earned wages
God will testify against those who oppress workers by withholding their pay
James warns that withheld wages from workers cry out to the Lord, and the Lord hears their cry
Context verses describing whom this law applies to - poor and needy workers
Warning against exploiting the poor, for the Lord will plead their cause
Jesus confirms the principle that the worker is worthy of his wages
Paul quotes the principle that the worker is worthy of his wages
